issues.t: Intake manifold gasket coolant leak
issues.sym: Coolant level keeps dropping with no puddle, a sweet smell, overheating, or milky, tan sludge under the oil cap.
issues.why: The V6 engines use plastic-framed lower intake gaskets that break down with age and the factory coolant. Coolant leaks outside the engine or into the oil. It is the most reported problem on the Grand Am.
issues.next: Watch the coolant level and temperature gauge. Stop driving if it overheats. Have the gaskets replaced before coolant mixes with the oil and damages the engine bearings.

issues.t: Passlock anti-theft no-start
issues.sym: The engine cranks but won't start or starts and dies, and the security light flashes or stays on. Waiting about 10 minutes with the key on sometimes lets it start.
issues.why: The Passlock sensor in the ignition lock cylinder fails or loses its signal, so the anti-theft system cuts fuel.
issues.next: Try the 10-minute key-on relearn to get home. A shop usually fixes it for good by replacing the lock cylinder sensor or installing a bypass module.

issues.t: Engine cranks but won't start
issues.sym: The engine turns over normally but won't fire, sometimes only now and then.
issues.why: Owners trace it to several parts: the anti-theft system, a worn ignition switch, the crankshaft or camshaft sensor, or the fuel pump. Many never find a single cause, which makes it the most reported Grand Am complaint.
issues.next: Note whether the security light is on. Have a shop check for spark, fuel pressure and stored codes while it is acting up rather than swapping parts.

issues.t: Head gasket leak, coolant in the oil
issues.sym: Overheating, white exhaust smoke, coolant loss, or a milky look to the oil.
issues.why: The 2.4L Twin Cam is known for head gasket failures, often after an overheat.
issues.next: Stop driving if it overheats. A cooling system pressure test and combustion leak test will confirm it.

issues.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing
issues.sym: Slipping, harsh or delayed shifts, or the car not moving in a gear.
issues.why: The 4-speed automatic wears internally at higher mileage, and owners report failures around 90,000 miles.
issues.next: Check the fluid. Have codes read before approving a rebuild.

issues.t: Ignition switch can slip out of Run (recall)
issues.sym: The engine shuts off while driving, often after a bump or with a heavy key ring. Power steering and power brake assist are lost, and airbags may not deploy.
issues.why: The ignition switch can be knocked out of the Run position (recall 14V-400).
issues.next: Use only the ignition key with nothing else on the ring, and have a dealer complete the recall.

issues.t: Ignition switch can overheat during long cranking (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell or smoke from the steering column, or a melted switch, after cranking a hard-to-start engine for a long time.
issues.why: Holding the key in Start for a long time can overheat parts inside the switch (recalls 02V-070 and 04V-036).
issues.next: Don't hold the key in Start. Check that the recall was done.

issues.t: Key won't turn or ignition switch wears out
issues.sym: The key gets hard to turn or won't turn, or the car won't crank even though the dash lights come on.
issues.why: The ignition lock cylinder and switch wear out on these cars.
issues.next: Don't force the key. A worn lock cylinder or switch is usually replaced, and the Passlock relearn is done at the same time.

issues.t: Window drops into the door
issues.sym: A window falls down into the door or won't go up or down.
issues.why: The power window regulator breaks.
issues.next: Tape the glass up to keep weather out and have the regulator replaced.

issues.t: Turn signals work only some of the time
issues.sym: The turn signals or hazard lights stop flashing now and then.
issues.why: The hazard switch, which turn signals also pass through, develops cracked solder joints.
issues.next: Have the hazard switch checked. It is a fairly simple repair.

issues.t: Turn signals and hazard lights can fail (recall)
issues.sym: Turn signals or hazard lights work only sometimes or not at all.
issues.why: Solder joints inside the hazard switch can crack (recall 03V-327).
issues.next: Check the recall with your VIN. The fix is free.

issues.t: Clicking from behind the dash
issues.sym: A repeated clicking from behind the dashboard, sometimes with the car off.
issues.why: A relay or module behind the dash cycles on and off. Owners report this mostly on 2004 models.
issues.next: Have an electrical shop find which relay or module is clicking; a dying battery can also be a sign of it.

issues.t: Dashboard gauges stop working
issues.sym: The speedometer, fuel gauge or other gauges stop or act erratically.
issues.why: The instrument cluster fails on these older cars.
issues.next: A cluster repair shop can usually rebuild it for less than a new part.

issues.t: Timing chain rattle on cold start
issues.sym: A rattle for a few seconds after a cold start, or timing codes.
issues.why: The 2.2L Ecotec timing chain and tensioner wear, especially if oil changes were skipped.
issues.next: Get it checked early. A broken chain can damage the engine.

issues.t: Water pump leak
issues.sym: Coolant drips near the front of the engine or the coolant level drops.
issues.why: The 2.2L Ecotec water pump seal is known to leak.
issues.next: Fix it before the engine overheats.

issues.t: Steering column bolt may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Looseness or play in the steering.
issues.why: The lower steering column pinch bolt may not have been tightened enough (recall 96V-249).
issues.next: Check the recall with your VIN.

issues.t: Hazard lights may not flash (recall)
issues.sym: The front or rear hazard lights don't flash when switched on.
issues.why: A defect in the hazard circuit (recall 96V-250).
issues.next: Check the recall with your VIN.

issues.t: Interior lights turn on by themselves (recall)
issues.sym: Dome and courtesy lights turn on suddenly while driving.
issues.why: An interior lighting control fault (recall 98V-027).
issues.next: Check the recall with your VIN.

issues.t: Missing fuse box cover can short and start a fire (recall)
issues.sym: Smoke or burning under the hood near the fuse box.
issues.why: A protective cover on the underhood fuse center may be missing, letting a terminal short against the battery cable (recall 97V-059).
issues.next: Check the recall with your VIN.

issues.t: Steering wheel nut may loosen (recall)
issues.sym: The steering wheel feels loose on its shaft.
issues.why: The steering wheel retaining nut may not have been tightened correctly (recall 98V-320).
issues.next: Check the recall with your VIN.

issues.t: Center console lid may open in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom in daily use.
issues.why: The console cover latch may not hold under load (recall 00V-140).
issues.next: Check the recall with your VIN.

issues.t: Rear trailing arm bolt can back out (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk from the left rear, or the car pulling.
issues.why: A bolt holding the rear trailing arm to the knuckle may be under-tightened (recall 00V-116).
issues.next: Check the recall with your VIN.

issues.t: Manual transmission can stay in gear when shifted to Reverse (recall)
issues.sym: On manual cars, shifting from fifth to reverse leaves it in fourth, and the key can come out while in gear.
issues.why: A reverse shift inhibitor fault (recall 00V-372).
issues.next: Use the parking brake every time you park and check the recall.

issues.t: Accelerator pedal can stick in hot weather (recall)
issues.sym: The gas pedal is slow to return or the engine stays revved after you lift your foot.
issues.why: In heat, the accelerator pedal arm can bind (recall 04V-528).
issues.next: If it happens, shift to Neutral and brake. Check the recall.

issues.t: Fuel tank weld can leak (recall)
issues.sym: Gas smell or drips under the rear of the car.
issues.why: Some fuel tanks had a weak weld (recall 04V-301).
issues.next: Don't drive with a fuel smell. Check the recall.

issues.t: Rear knuckle bolts can break (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk from the rear or the car wandering.
issues.why: Some rear suspension knuckle bolts were substandard and can fracture (recall 05V-054).
issues.next: Check the recall with your VIN.
